title: Great night overall! Good...
text: Great night overall! Good mix of bar/club. Had the best time dancing and knowing facts about the gay night/district of Barcelona. Orxan had been extremely warm tour guide and made everybody involved in the tour be as relax and comfortable
author: fn2nmw6rt6

title: Great Time in Barcelona
text: I travelled to Spain on my own but wanted to explore the city safely. So when I heard about the Bar Crawl, I figured I’d give it a go. I am so happy I did. What an amazing introduction to Barcelona and its diverse nightlife. The companionship was just what I needed to make the experience more memorable.
author: Jimmie_M

title: Highly recommend
text: This was no ordinary bar crawl, the small group allowed for personal connection and flowing conversation and our guide was extremely knowledgeable about the hidden gems of Barcelona. There is something on the crawl for every tailored interest. Highly recommend for anyone seeking fun new experiences, good conversation, and exploration of Barcelona night life with ease.
author: Richard_G

title: A fun night out
text: I had a blast! totally recommended for solo travelers to explore the local gay scene and make new friends in the process. Definitely a night to remember from my trip :)
author: Jaime_M

title: Great idea specially if...
text: Great idea specially if you are visiting solo or as a couple and want to bar hop with some quick friends!
author: Noa_N

title: A fun night out in Barcelona
text: I had a great time! Our guide Orkhan was entertaining, knowledgeable of the city and flexible about the kind of evening we could have. We ended up having a high energy night like we wanted but he appeared to be open to showing us a more chill experience. He asked us early on what kind of evening we wanted to have. I made 6 or 7 friends through the experience. I would do this again in Barcelona or another city. A lot of fun.
author: Shamari_S

title: Gay Bar Crawl
text: Orkhan was a great host. He took us to three bars in the area, all with different vibes. It was fun and easy meeting the other solo travellers. Would recommend to any solo travellers while in Barcelona.
author: Richard_R

title: Amazing night out!
text: At first I was hesitant,but so glad I decided to book the pub crawl. I meet so many great people, also solo travelers. We hit up a variety of places, something for everyone’s tasts. Okra did an amazing time and definitely looked out for all of us. I highly recommend!
author: Paul_D

title: Amazing night
text: It was the best night in Barcelona. Thanks to Orxan   He is the best guide. I definitely recommend especially for solo travelers. I loved the experience.
author: Mertcan_A

title: Type A Planner approved
text: Orkhan was a lovely guide thru Barcelona's gay district and introduced us to a handful of very unique bars, from dance-y to more chill lounges, and ended the night with an exciting after-party. Even though I plan most of my international trips in advance, it is worth it to have an advisor to jumpstart this vacation!
